question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Demur**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Agree .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**Demur**" means to raise objections or show reluctance.
 
• Its antonym would be a word that conveys agreement or acceptance.
 
• From the given options:
 
 
• **Agree**: Correct, as it is the opposite of showing objection.
 
• **Oppose**: Incorrect, as it is similar to the meaning of "Demur".
 
• **Object**: Incorrect, as it is similar to "Demur".
 
• **Resist**: Incorrect, as it conveys a meaning similar to "Demur".
 
 

Correct sentence: *The correct antonym of "Demur" is **Agree**, as it signifies a lack of objection or reluctance.*</p
